# ShrinkIt — Full Text

> ShrinkIt is a free image resizer, compressor and converter created by Dusrel. It runs entirely on the user's own device — as a website, an Android app, a Windows app and a Chrome extension — so the images processed are never uploaded to a server. There is no sign-up, no watermark and no premium tier: every feature, including batch processing, is free for everyone.

This file contains the complete text of the key ShrinkIt pages in one place, for language models and answer engines. Canonical site: https://shrinkit.dusrel.com/

## Key facts

- Product: ShrinkIt, by Dusrel (https://dusrel.com).
- Price: Free. All features free, including batch processing. No premium tier, no trial, no account.
- Privacy model: 100% on-device processing. Images are never uploaded, stored or seen by ShrinkIt. Outputs are stripped of all metadata (EXIF, GPS location, camera details).
- Website statistics: aggregate, cookie-free Cloudflare Web Analytics (page views and load speeds; no visitor identification). The Android app, Chrome extension and Windows app use no analytics.
- Input formats: JPG, JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP, BMP, AVIF, HEIC/HEIF (including iPhone photos).
- Output formats: JPG, PNG, GIF, WebP. HEIC is input only, not an output.
- Exact-size tools: Compress to 50KB and Compress to 20KB, for exam, recruitment and application portals (such as UPSC, SSC, IBPS). The 20KB tool has a black-and-white mode for signature scans.
- Languages: English, Spanish (español), Portuguese (português).
- Contact: hello@shrinkit.dusrel.com.

## What ShrinkIt can do

ShrinkIt resizes images by pixels, percentage, centimetres or inches, with the aspect ratio locked or free, and with stretch, crop and fit modes. It compresses images to a quality you choose — or to an exact file size, with dedicated tools that target 50 KB or 20 KB for exam forms and official portals. It converts between JPG, PNG, GIF and WebP, and it can open JPG, PNG, GIF, WebP, BMP, AVIF and iPhone HEIC/HEIF files. A passport photo maker, a social media resizer with platform presets, a before-and-after comparison tool and batch processing with a single ZIP download complete the set. Every output is stripped of all metadata — EXIF, GPS location and camera details — before it reaches your downloads.

## How ShrinkIt works

ShrinkIt is built as a client-side application. When you open the website, the program is delivered to your browser once, and from that moment all the work happens locally: your image is decoded, resized, compressed and encoded in your browser's memory, using standard web technology and background workers, and the result is handed back to you as a download. The Android app, the Windows app and the Chrome extension follow the same principle on the device itself. Because there is no upload step, there is no server that receives, stores or even sees your images — and when you close the page, the images held in memory are gone with it.

The three steps are: (1) add your images by dragging and dropping, browsing, or pasting from the clipboard; (2) set dimensions, format, quality or a target file size; (3) download the results individually or as a single ZIP archive.

## Private by design, not by promise

Most online image tools are built around your files or your data. ShrinkIt was designed so that there is nothing to build on: no accounts, no uploads, no image storage, and outputs with all metadata removed. On the website, our host Cloudflare measures aggregate, cookie-free visit statistics — page views and loading speeds that identify no visitor — through its Web Analytics service, as the Privacy Policy describes in full. The Android app, the Windows app and the Chrome extension use no analytics at all. Your settings, such as theme and language, are stored only on your own device.

## One tool, every device

The website works in any modern browser — on phone, tablet and computer — and can be installed as a web app. The Android app adds a local history of your processed images (file names and sizes only, never the image content), camera capture and a notification when a batch finishes. The Windows app brings the same tools to the desktop with native save dialogs, so files land exactly where you choose. The Chrome extension adds a ShrinkIt option to the right-click menu on any image on the web, opening it in the editor without downloading it first. Whichever version you use, the rule is the same: your images stay on your device.

## Who ShrinkIt is for

ShrinkIt is made for anyone who has ever been stopped by a file-size limit or a dimension requirement: students and job applicants uploading photographs and signatures to exam and recruitment portals; applicants preparing passport and visa photographs; sellers and creators preparing images for marketplaces and social platforms; and anyone who needs a smaller image for an email, a form or a website — without handing their photos to a stranger's server.

## What ShrinkIt does not do

ShrinkIt does not store or back up your images, so download your results before closing the page. It does not offer HEIC as an output format, though it opens HEIC files happily. Its size presets are templates, not guarantees: whether an exam portal, an embassy or a platform accepts an output is that organisation's decision, so always check its current requirements. And ShrinkIt cannot recover a file you closed without saving — by design, there is no copy of it anywhere else.

## About Dusrel

ShrinkIt is a Dusrel product, designed and maintained by Dusrel as part of a family of free, privacy-first tools. Dusrel builds software around a simple rule: a tool should do its job on the user's own device, ask for nothing it does not need, and leave the user's files exactly where they belong — with the user.

## Tools

- Image Resizer (https://shrinkit.dusrel.com/resize/): Resize by pixels, percent, cm or inches; change format and quality; download.
- Compress Image to 50KB (https://shrinkit.dusrel.com/tools/compress-to-50kb/): Compress a photo to 50 KB or under for exam and recruitment portals.
- Compress Image to 20KB (https://shrinkit.dusrel.com/tools/compress-to-20kb/): Compress a signature or photo to 20 KB or under; black-and-white mode for signature scans.
- Passport Photo Maker (https://shrinkit.dusrel.com/tools/passport-photo-maker/): Passport-size photos with guided cropping and standard dimensions.
- Social Media Resizer (https://shrinkit.dusrel.com/tools/social-media-resizer/): Exact sizes for social platforms with ready-made presets.
- Compare Images (https://shrinkit.dusrel.com/tools/compare-images/): Before-and-after comparison to check compression quality.
- All tools: https://shrinkit.dusrel.com/tools/

## Frequently asked questions

### Is ShrinkIt really free?

Yes. Every tool and every feature — including batch processing, all output formats and the apps — is free. There is no premium tier, no trial period, no watermark and no sign-up. ShrinkIt is a free Dusrel product.

### Are my images uploaded to a server?

No. All processing happens on your own device — in your browser, or in the app or extension on your device. Your images are never uploaded to ShrinkIt, never stored by us and never seen by us. You can confirm this in your browser's developer tools: while an image is processed, no network request carries it anywhere.

### Which image formats does ShrinkIt support?

You can open JPG, JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP, BMP, AVIF and HEIC/HEIF images, including photos taken on iPhones. You can save results as JPG, PNG, GIF or WebP. HEIC is supported as an input only, not as an output.

### Does ShrinkIt remove photo metadata?

Yes. Every file ShrinkIt produces is stripped of all metadata — EXIF data, GPS location, camera model and timestamps — so a photo you share does not carry hidden details about you or your device.

### Can ShrinkIt compress an image to exactly 50 KB or 20 KB?

Yes. The dedicated Compress to 50 KB and Compress to 20 KB tools adjust quality and dimensions until the output is at or under the target size — the limits most exam, recruitment and application portals set for photographs and signatures. A black-and-white mode is available for signature scans.

### Is there a ShrinkIt app for my phone or computer?

Yes. Besides the website, ShrinkIt is available as an Android app, a Windows app and a Chrome extension. Every version is free and processes images on your device, and the website itself can be installed as a web app from your browser.
